0022600194.text: The Houston Rockets (7-2, 3-1 on the road, lost their last game) visit the Phoenix Suns (2-5, 0-3 at home... no, 2-2 at home and 0-3 on the road, won their last game) in the Rockets' 10th game of the season. Houston is without Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain), both listed as out, while Phoenix is missing Mark Williams (shoulder surgery) and has Jordan Goodwin (calf) and Rasheer Fleming (ankle sprain) listed as day-to-day and gametime decisions. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Rockets won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, including a 119-105 win in Phoenix on April 7, 2026.
